fact_text: MG Motors Pakistan says it sells comfort, lifestyle and safety, not only resale value, durability, parts availability and fuel mileage, which it says Japanese brands emphasise.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can MG Motors Beat the Japanese Giants? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-14)

fact_text: MG Motors Pakistan says it has introduced a plug-in hybrid (PHEV) and plans a gradual shift toward EVs to change customer lifestyles.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can MG Motors Beat the Japanese Giants? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-14)

fact_text: The Lahore plant's welding shop assembles 88 parts per body before paint: e-coat, sealer, PVC underbody coating, primer, then top coat in black, red and silver.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can MG Motors Beat the Japanese Giants? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-14)

fact_text: MG says its roofs are laser-brazed, which it says reduces water leakage and cabin noise and keeps body accuracy tight enough for robotic roof work.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can MG Motors Beat the Japanese Giants? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-14)

fact_text: MG's coordinate measuring machine (CMM) checks every body spot and flags deviations in red, yellow and green; body accuracy must stay above 95% or the process is held.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can MG Motors Beat the Japanese Giants? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-14)

fact_text: The final line fills fuel, air-conditioning gas and coolant; a connected end-of-line system monitors each vehicle's data before the car goes to final testing.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can MG Motors Beat the Japanese Giants? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-14)

fact_text: MG has dealerships in Sargodha, Lyallpur and Sialkot and says it plans a presence in Jhelum and Gujranwala.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can MG Motors Beat the Japanese Giants? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-14)

fact_text: MG says it is localising production, with batteries already local, to keep prices down for consumers, which it calls a business need.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can MG Motors Beat the Japanese Giants? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-14)

fact_text: MG says its new models meet Euro 5 emission standards, and that a Punjab government emissions test favours newer-technology cars.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can MG Motors Beat the Japanese Giants? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-14)

fact_text: MG says homologation standards require cars to be fully certified before sale and that it will not compromise on safety.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can MG Motors Beat the Japanese Giants? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-14)

fact_text: MG aims to be present in almost all vehicle segments by 2030, including budget, sedan and D-segment cars, and in some segments by 2027, if manufacturing policy support continues.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can MG Motors Beat the Japanese Giants? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-14)

fact_text: The auto development policy lets greenfield assemblers import 100% of their kits until June 2026, and most of their kits are still imported.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can MG Motors Beat the Japanese Giants? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-14)

fact_text: MG's management said Pakistan's auto market growth to 2030 depends on policy decisions, and growth will come if policy keeps supporting manufacturing.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can MG Motors Beat the Japanese Giants? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-14)

fact_text: MG's management said EVs will disrupt the auto industry and that adoption will take less than three years.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can MG Motors Beat the Japanese Giants? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-14)
